glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形): a man 大 then drawn as a woman (女) with two hands pointing to his/her midsection. On top of the character there was huge eye 目, then stylized as a horn 角. The hands gradually shifted upwards; hence, a nearly original version of the character is 𡢗. All the upper part was eventually stylized as 覀. Unrelated to 栗 but partly related to 票. Original meaning was “waist” (now 腰).
senses: [yāo] to demand; to ask; to request
[yào] to wish to have or keep
